Approved source-backed provisional1922-12-30 snapshot. Mixed source dates, claim/occupation distinction and registrations retained in immutable ZIP. Other non-Caspian/Aral/Arctic coastline context is NE5.1.1; not2026 surveyed coast. Selection through1925-05-12 by user instruction; the source remains a1922-12-30 reconstruction. Local Dniester boundary follows the built-in modern watercourse by user approval (2026-10-25); not a surveyed or legally delimited 1922 thalweg. Baseline ZIP hashes remain evidence identifiers, not hashes of this locally adjusted geometry. The approximately 1 km river-to-preserved-coast closure (2.87 CSS pixels at app maximum zoom) is geometric inference, not independently established historical boundary. European exterior revised from user-approved Finland/Estonia/Latvia/Poland reconstruction; existing sea coastline and Dniester retained. Modern river/shared sections preserved; only confirmed Latvia dry-land detail lightly simplified. Original ZIP hashes identify baseline evidence, not this adjusted geometry.
